course.title: Probability and Statistical Analysis
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: You want to estimate the average ages of kids that ride a particular kid's ride at Disneyland. You take a random sample of 8 kids exiting the ride, and find that their ages are 2,3,4,5,6,6,7,7. Assume that ages are roughly normally distributed.
(i) Calculate the sample mean, (ii) Calculate the sample standard distribution, (iii) Calculate the standard error of the mean, (iv) Calculate the 99% confidence interval.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
